home.subtitle: A mind sync party game
home.description: Drop a clue about a secret target on the spectrum. The closer the guess, the more points!

tutorial.title: How to Play
tutorial.intro: Learn the basics in 6 quick steps. The game is all about syncing minds on a spectrum.

objective.title: The Goal
objective.description: Players take turns on the same phone. Whoever's holding the phone sees a secret target on a spectrum and gives a clue for the others to guess where it lies.

clue.title: Give the Clue
clue.description: The clue giver secretly sees a target on the dial and a spectrum card. Invent one word or phrase that hints at where the target sits between the two extremes.

passPhone.title: Pass the Phone
passPhone.description: Say your clue out loud, then hand the phone to the guesser without showing them the target.

guess.title: Drag the Needle
guess.description: The guesser sees the same spectrum but no target. Drag the needle to wherever the clue feels right.

scoring.title: Score the Round
scoring.description: The closer your guess is to the target, the more points you earn.

winning.title: Win the Match
winning.description: Roles change every round. The first to reach the target score takes the match.

roundFlow.title: Round mode
roundFlow.allGuessDesc: Each round, one player gives the clue and everyone else tries to guess.
roundFlow.singleGuessDesc: One psychic and one guesser are picked each round.
roundFlow.scoringHint: The clue giver earns one point for each player who scores, and guessers also score by distance.

clue.subtitle: Look at the target and think of a clue
clue.instruction: Say the clue out loud and press "pass the phone" to {{name}}

guess.subtitle: Drag the needle to where you think the clue is

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the interface and default spectrum language.

haptics.title: Haptics
haptics.description: Turn off if you'd rather play without vibration feedback.
haptics.descriptionAndroid: Turn off if you'd rather play without sound feedback.
